title: 'New Work Order' in the cell menu points the user to the Work Orders tab
permissions_required: Schedule: View / Edit and Work Orders access. Confirm the exact behaviour and permission live at VIU.
preconditions: 1. You are on the Schedule grid.
2. The cell context menu shows 'Create Event' and 'New Work Order' (SCH-REAS-03).
steps: 2. Choose 'New Work Order' from the menu.
expected: 1. The menu offers a 'New Work Order' item.
2. Choosing it directs the user to create a work order (a toast / prompt pointing to the Work Orders tab).
3. The exact target flow (toast or navigation) is confirmed during live testing.
